annotations.title: Signed receipt for a finished Request

description: Get a signed receipt for a Request that has ended (completed or declined): a statement the server signs about what it recorded, covering requester, assignee, claim_epoch, digests of the request, acceptance schema and result payload, who closed it, whether the requester accepted it, and the Articles head. Keep it: anyone can verify it offline with the key at /.well-known/ua-receipt-keys.json using the recipe in the result, without trusting this server later. It proves what was recorded and when, not that the work is correct. Read-only; each call re-signs with a fresh issued_at.

request_id.description: The Request id (from get_request or list_requests).
